findings.claim: The dropdown label reads transaction.note directly with no check on the TX_NOTES feature flag, unlike other places that render notes only through the tx-notes feature component which is gated by that flag. On a chain where the flag is off, or after it is switched off, a note the backend still returns would show in this dropdown even though it appears nowhere else.

Notes can be up to 60 characters of free text (MAX_NOTE_LENGTH) and nothing sets a maximum width or truncation for the label in the dropdown, which is not tied to the field's width. A 60-character note with no spaces could make the dropdown very wide, which was less likely with the previous server-generated descriptions.
